title: Signposts in Academic Writing
text:
Good writers guide their readers through an argument by using linking adverbials and signposts. Words such as 'however', 'therefore' and 'in contrast' show how one idea relates to another. Furthermore, signposts like 'first of all' or 'to conclude' tell readers where they are in the text. Without these devices, even a well-reasoned essay can feel confusing and disjointed.

Nevertheless, signposts must be used with care. Overusing them can make a text sound mechanical, because readers begin to notice the connectors rather than the content. Moreover, a linking word that signals the wrong relationship can mislead the reader. For this reason, skilled writers choose each connector deliberately, so that it reflects the true logic of the argument.

questions.text: According to the passage, what do words such as 'however' and 'therefore' show?
options: How one idea relates to another

questions.text: What problem can occur when signposts are overused, according to the passage?
options: Readers stop noticing the content and focus on the connectors
Readers can no longer read the title
The writer loses the argument entirely

questions.text: What can be inferred about a writer who chooses each connector deliberately?
options: They pay attention to the logical relationship between ideas
They avoid using any linking words at all
They write only for readers who already agree
They prefer short texts with no argument

questions.text: Why does the second paragraph warn that a wrong linking word can mislead the reader?
options: Because the relationship a connector signals shapes how the reader interprets the argument
Because readers never read the second paragraph
Because connectors change the spelling of other words
Because mistakes in punctuation always confuse readers

vocabulary.definition: words or phrases that show readers where they are in a text and how ideas connect
lacking a clear connection between parts
done in a routine way, without thought or variety
done on purpose and with careful thought

paragraph_translations: Добрі автори ведуть читача крізь аргумент, використовуючи сполучні прислівники та маркери структури. Такі слова, як «however», «therefore» та «in contrast», показують, як одна ідея пов'язана з іншою. Крім того, маркери на кшталт «first of all» або «to conclude» підказують читачеві, де він перебуває в тексті. Без цих засобів навіть добре обґрунтований есей може звучати заплутано і роз'єднано.

Проте маркери треба використовувати обережно. Їх надмірне вживання може зробити текст механічним, адже читач починає помічати сполучники, а не зміст. Крім того, сполучне слово, яке передає хибне відношення, може ввести читача в оману. Тому досвідчені автори обирають кожен сполучник свідомо, щоб він відображав справжню логіку аргументу.
